purpose: Public summary of Argon's contribution, original-owner disposition and evidence limits. This is not a raw review transcript.

adbrain.name: Ad Brain
adbrain.title: One API improvement deployed; interface work remains.
adbrain.summary: An independent source read checked 112 code and evidence-pack claims: 41 confirmed fully or in part, 44 refuted wholly or in their named mechanism, 3 already fixed and 24 not checkable. These are audit counts, not a quality score.
adbrain.before: Can the source substantiate the advisory findings, and which ones belong in the existing build?
adbrain.after: Two source-backed recommendations are now in the original marketing build plan: explain attribution overlap and show wallet source and read time.
adbrain.result: The attribution upper-bound API warning is merged and present in the verified production source. Its visible warning and wallet source/read-time interface work remain separate accepted follow-ups. User and commercial benefit remain unmeasured.

stages.title: Check the claims against source.
stages.text: An independent source read checked 112 code and evidence-pack claims: 41 confirmed fully or in part, 44 refuted wholly or in their named mechanism, 3 already fixed and 24 not checkable. These are audit counts, not a quality score.
stages.state: 112 claims checked / not a quality score

stages.title: Two improvements added to the build plan.
stages.text: The original marketing lead added both findings to its build plan. The attribution warning is assigned to the existing writer; its on-screen explanation follows in the interface work. The wallet row follows the existing Today-page change so two writers do not edit the same file.

stages.title: The API warning is merged and deployed.
stages.text: PR #4769 merged on 22 October at 16:39 UTC. The production deployment succeeded at 21:46 UTC, and its matched-attribution source exactly matches the reviewed file. The warning labels possible overlap without guessing a deduction.

stages.title: Finish the interface and measure the result.
stages.text: The visible upper-bound explanation and wallet source/read-time display remain separate accepted interface work. No customer-behavior or commercial improvement has been measured. Promo deduplication in the same API PR was pre-existing work and is not credited to Argon.

evidence.title: Source audit of the earlier advisory
evidence.text: An independent source read checked 112 code and evidence-pack claims: 41 confirmed fully or in part, 44 refuted wholly or in their named mechanism, 3 already fixed and 24 not checkable. These are audit counts, not a quality score.

evidence.title: Label matched attribution as an upper bound.
evidence.text: The source audit confirmed that matched attribution can overlap. The accepted change adds an upper-bound explanation to the API result and, in the interface work, beside the figure. It will not subtract a guessed overlap.

evidence.title: Bring existing wallet truth and read time into Today.
evidence.text: The accepted Today-page change reuses the existing wallet reader, distinguishes a provider-read balance from one entered by a person, and shows the read time.

evidence.title: API warning merged and deployed
evidence.date: 22 October 2026 · merged 16:39 UTC; production success 21:46 UTC
evidence.text: PR #4769 merged as 956a9169. The release receipt identifies production source 7ecc3dc and an exact reviewed/deployed match for matched_mer.py. Only the upper-bound warning is attributed to this advisory; separate promo-deduplication work is excluded. This is source-deployment proof, not a rendered interface or measured-outcome result.

evidence.title: Original-owner build plan
evidence.text: The original marketing lead added both findings to its build plan. The attribution warning is assigned to the existing writer; its on-screen explanation follows in the interface work. The wallet row follows the existing Today-page change so two writers do not edit the same file.

evidence.title: Earlier advisory decisions retained
evidence.text: Google grading and wallet readiness were accepted for evidence follow-up; store-sales attribution was deferred. Source inspection corrected the claim that no Google pipeline exists. These earlier decisions do not supply release or user-outcome proof.

adbrain.limit: The API source deployment is verified. Visible warning and wallet follow-ups, live account behavior and user outcomes need their own evidence. Original reviewers and release requirements remain unchanged. No private figures, account details or other reviewers’ scores are published.

studio.name: Studio
studio.title: A useful critique can be wrong.
studio.summary: Full-source review corrected two claims from excerpts. The native evidence gap remains real.
studio.before: Does a failed library load leave the creator without recovery?
studio.after: The full source already explains failure, offers retry and filters unsupported props. Those two repairs were not admitted.
studio.result: Two excerpt-based findings corrected. No product change or measured lift attributed to Argon.

stages.title: Recovery and filtering were questioned.
stages.text: The advisory questioned failed library loading and unsupported prop choices using a limited source excerpt. These were claims to check against the complete implementation.

stages.title: The original owner reads the full source.
stages.text: The full source shows a loading explanation, retry and unsupported-prop filtering. Existing availability labels, locked items and chosen model and pose are preserved. The two core failure claims were corrected.

stages.title: Keep the working behavior.
stages.text: No repair was admitted for those two claims. The owner preserved the existing code and review history. This triage dispatched no new test or provider job.

stages.title: Retain the real evidence gap.
stages.text: Native measurement remains unfinished under its original owner. Text and source analysis cannot establish phone interaction quality, a rendered score or a new acceptance pass.
stages.state: Native gap retained / no final visual score

evidence.title: Studio original-owner finding disposition
evidence.text: Complete-source validation: CF-1 recovery claim contradicted; CF-2 unsupported prop exposure not demonstrated; CF-3 native gap accepted as already tracked.

evidence.title: Evidence scope
evidence.text: Source validation only. No product changes, runtime experiment, test dispatch or additional review round.

evidence.title: Original-owner public contribution summary
evidence.text: No attributable product change; new user outcome unknown. Time saved and commercial uplift unmeasured. Optional enhancements remain proposals.

evidence.title: Image review route now verified
evidence.text: A separate supervised advisory read four approved interface fixture images and returned visual feedback. The client recorded Argon High; independent server model attestation is absent. The chair admitted this route for approved Studio images. The original Studio owner checked the receipt and recorded the conditions; its earlier review scope is already consumed and has no outstanding visual call. No new image submission, score or shipped improvement is claimed.

studio.limit: The advisory read excerpts. The owner disposition used complete source. Native behavior and the overall visual rating remain unverified.

website.name: Website
website.title: Directions are not a promise.
website.summary: The critique sharpened the distinction between finding a store and knowing that a trip will succeed.
website.before: Does a directory and a directions link give a shopper enough certainty?
website.after: Keep existing directions and optional location. Connect the selected store with validated current item and size in the existing enquiry preview, refreshing or clearing stale context before the shopper chooses whether to continue.
website.result: A bounded build brief now connects current product and size to the selected store through the existing enquiry preview. Original writer and shared-file custody are being reconciled. No implementation, release or measured benefit is claimed yet.

stages.title: Follow the intention beyond the click.
stages.text: The advisory distinguished a directions link from confirmed stock or an accepted store request. It proposed checking the evidence behind each promise to the shopper.

stages.title: Keep the existing design and owners.
stages.text: The original owner preserved the directory and design, then sent one smaller question about product, variant and store context. Reading that same conversation confirmed a provider error. No additional answer, score or repeat submission.

stages.title: Separate existing release work.
stages.text: First Look's two CSS files are installed in the unpublished draft. That is verified original-owner release work; this exhibit does not attribute it to Argon's advice.

stages.title: Leave unobserved measures unknown.
stages.text: The advisory could not render the live site. Its visual and interaction measures remain unknown. Installed source, phone acceptance and final ratings are separate gates.

evidence.title: Website advisory responses
evidence.text: Completed responses explicitly declined a composite release score because live rendering was unavailable.

evidence.title: Bound context extension
evidence.text: The accepted incremental question returned a provider error in the original conversation. The visible mode was Argon High; no additional advice or score was recovered. No retry was submitted.

evidence.title: First Look installation receipts
evidence.text: Both approved CSS files installed and matched; unpublished draft and private OFF state preserved. No rendered, native or rating credit.

evidence.title: Original-owner Big Bag draft installation
evidence.date: 22 October 2026 · hosted verification 13:21 UTC; census adopted 13:27 UTC
evidence.text: Reviewed Big Bag and title CSS are installed in the unpublished draft with exact hosted bytes and preservation. Title fit passed at320/380/1280 on23October. Header arrival follow-up is also installed; its changed first-arrival rendering, native checks and final ratings remain open. These original-owner releases are not attributed to Argon.

evidence.title: Shared advisory route proved
evidence.text: Four supervised calls completed on another system with High recorded by client logs. This establishes the route only. The earlier Website response still requires collection; no duplicate Website submission or new visual score is claimed.

evidence.title: Stores enquiry integration brief delivered
evidence.text: Source inspection found that Stores offers directions but does not connect its selected store to the existing product-and-size enquiry helper. One bounded implementation brief was delivered through the original owner map. It preserves the existing recipient and preview, with sending left to the shopper. Writer/shared-file custody is pending; no stock, reservation, foot-traffic or conversion claim is added.

website.limit: A map click is intent, a confirmed arrival is a separate observation, and a sale is another event. None is a substitute for the next.

companion.name: Shopping Companion
companion.title: Separate the proof from the recovery.
companion.summary: Original-owner validation reinforced five boundary checks, separated two proof paths and corrected two assumptions.
companion.before: Does read-only staff binding verification need to wait for a separate recovery flow?
companion.after: C17 read-only verification can proceed on its own qualified source and context. S02 recovery still needs an ownership receipt tied to the actual draft.
companion.result: Boundary checks reinforced and an advisory-only dependency corrected. New implementation attributable to this advice remains unverified.

stages.title: Check the real handoff boundaries.
stages.text: The advice proposed checks around identity, strict query and lineage, read versus acknowledgement, attribution and uncertain-write handling across the existing connected journey.

stages.title: The original owner validates and corrects.
stages.text: A2 checked the complete source. C17 mounts a private server route, not a storefront acknowledgement control. S02 still needs an ownership receipt tied to the actual draft.

stages.title: Continue each original proof path.
stages.text: C17 read-only verification does not depend on S02 recovery. It still requires its own qualified source and authenticated context. The original release path continues; no speculative patch or duplicate proof was opened.

stages.title: Preserve unknown outcomes.
stages.text: Five boundary checks are reinforced. An uncertain write remains unknown and is never blindly replayed. Attributable new implementation and connected acceptance remain unverified.

evidence.title: Companion original-owner disposition
evidence.text: The advice reinforced five boundary checks and separating C17 read-only verification from S02 recovery. Source checking corrected two assumptions: the C17 change mounts a private server route, and S02 still needs an ownership receipt tied to the actual draft. The existing release path continues; uncertain writes remain unknown and are never replayed.

evidence.title: Scope of adoption
evidence.text: Only missing observations continue under original owners and existing grants. No new suite, counted review round or speculative validation patch was created to consume the advice.

companion.limit: A useful contribution can clarify a dependency without proving a new product improvement. Existing release progress is not retroactively attributed to this advisory.

embedding.name: Embedding engine
embedding.title: Keep the safeguards. Test the remaining questions.
embedding.summary: The original Search owner checked 19 material claims. Tenant/model separation, image-change handling and explicit no-match states already exist. The review clarified the remaining evidence gaps and restored a catalogue result the advisory omitted.
embedding.before: Should EmbeddingGemma 2 be kept, improved, repurposed or retired?
embedding.after: Preserve working safeguards, distinguish catalogue experiments from customer-photo performance, and require actual usage and cost evidence before any service decision.
embedding.result: 19 claims checked against 22 source links and five saved receipt hashes. Retirement and new implementation are deferred. No deployed improvement, saving or final rating is credited to Argon.

stages.title: Identify what is actually running.
stages.text: The saved endpoint receipt identifies FashionSigLIP. The separate EmbeddingGemma 2 research allocation has different evidence. Recorded calls do not establish its current callers, hosting cost or user benefit.

stages.title: Correct the advice against working source.
stages.text: The implementation already separates tenants and models, handles image hashes and changed URLs, and returns needs-review or no-match states with candidate choices. The open questions are exact model revisions, caller attribution, measured calibration, complete image coverage and Studio-to-product bindings.
stages.state: 19 material claims checked / existing safeguards preserved

stages.title: Keep the useful counter-evidence.
stages.text: A historical 300-query cropped-catalogue experiment found the first match in 69.0% of cases with EmbeddingGemma 2 versus 62.3% with the incumbent. Argon omitted this result. It supports further catalogue research, not a customer-photo or Studio production benefit.
stages.state: Historical experiment / no new measured gain

stages.title: Decide only from the right evidence.
stages.text: The original owner deferred retirement and every proposed implementation or experiment. Current lab usage, queued work and hosting cost still need evidence. The existing customer-care trial conditions and Railway hold remain intact.
stages.state: No service change, new experiment or claimed saving

evidence.title: One completed advisory conversation
evidence.text: All four prepared calls returned in one conversation. Client logs identify Gemini 4 Argon at High; independent server model attestation is absent. No quality score was requested.

evidence.title: Original-owner source validation
evidence.text: The original Search owner checked 19 material claims against 22 source links and five saved receipt hashes. Several suggested mechanisms already exist; the remaining evidence gaps are recorded separately.

evidence.title: Catalogue evidence restored
evidence.text: The second catalogue experiment used 300 cropped queries over 3,706 products. Its 6.7 percentage-point first-match difference is historical research evidence. It is not a new Argon result or a measured production improvement.

evidence.title: Historical gains keep their original attribution
evidence.text: The earlier 5/22 to 6/22 customer-photo comparison predates the later repairs and Argon advisory. The five repairs were merged on 8 October and live-verified on 9–10 October. Their original final acceptance remains separate.

evidence.title: What remains undecided
evidence.text: No service retirement, new implementation, trial or infrastructure change was admitted. Current allocation cost, complete caller coverage and downstream benefit remain unknown.

embedding.limit: Source validation is complete; implementation and retirement are deferred. This contribution clarified evidence and corrected claims. It supplies no new product release, measured saving or substitute for the three original website ratings.
